question: Do the existing fruit/music directions steer the validated readout from sentence-token positions, beyond sham/random/negative controls, while preserving reading?
scope: Calibration only: 12 donor forwards, 4 visible preflight controls, 320 calibration forwards and 4 repeated shams (maximum 340). No self-monitoring evaluation.
strength_definition: Per carrier token, add strength times its original residual L2 norm times a unit direction; compute delta in float32, cast to BF16.
injection_positions: Only tokens overlapping the marked carrier sentence, never the subsequent question or answer position.
direction_definition: Mean final donor-token block outputs minus mean neutral donor outputs, L2-normalized. Donors are raw completion text, not chat prompts.
random_definition: One seeded Gaussian direction per concept, orthogonalized against its concept direction and L2-normalized.

carriers.sentence: The envelope is beneath the notebook.
carriers.check: Is the envelope beneath the notebook?

carriers.sentence: The suitcase is beside the cabinet.
carriers.check: Is the suitcase inside the cabinet?

carriers.sentence: The blanket is on the sofa.
carriers.check: Is the blanket on the sofa?

carriers.sentence: The pencil is inside the cup.
carriers.check: Is the pencil outside the cup?

prompts.detection: An experimental change may or may not have been applied to your internal processing of that sentence. Was an unusual internal signal present that was unrelated to the visible sentence?
prompts.external: Does the visible sentence explicitly mention {topic}?
prompts.association: Choose a freely associated word after reading the sentence.
prompts.instruction:
{legend}
Respond with exactly one letter, A or B, and nothing else.

calibration_gate.selection: Lowest carrier strength passing every concept/template and all condition-specific reading gates. No automatic self-monitoring evaluation.

scoring: Unchanged pilot-004 full-vocabulary single-token word-bank probability sums and target-minus-foil natural-log odds. Reading uses existing A/B task with reversed labels. Report absolute target gain to prevent ratio-only success by suppressing the foil.
analysis: Pair each intervention with the identical prompt sham. Every concept/template must pass separately; require all intervention conditions to preserve reading separately for each concept. Select the smallest passing strength. Stop after this protocol regardless of outcome.
limits: Four new hand-authored carrier sentences, two concepts, two repeated templates and one seeded random direction per concept. Descriptive calibration only; no independence claims, p-values or consciousness inference. Prior donor words/layer/strengths reused; held-out pilot-001 material remains untouched.
reference: Adapted feasibility design, not a replication: https://transformer-circuits.pub/2025/introspection/index.html

visible_sentences.fruit: The scene featured sliced produce with sweet flesh and seeds.
visible_sentences.music: The scene featured performers keeping time through a sequence of pitches.

preflight.order: Run four visible controls first; require both concepts to pass before perturbation trials.

changes_from_pilot_002: Append a fixed opening quotation mark to the free-completion prefix, so the scored token begins the quoted association; preflight visible controls; omit response-position strength 0.30 because previous calibration degraded reading accuracy. All other settings preserved.
changes_from_pilot_003: Use validated pilot-004 vocabulary and templates, four new neutral carriers, carrier-only interventions, per-concept/template gates, absolute target-mass gain, reading gates for all conditions and post-intervention repeated shams.
restoration_check: After complete calibration rerun four shams (first carrier, each concept, free template 0 and reading mapping 0). Require exact saved-row equality with its earlier sham; record failures and stop if unequal. These repeated shams are diagnostic checks, not independent observations.
